result.summary: Wrote tests/specs/DDL-05.md, MIG-01.md, MIG-02.md, MIG-03.md tracing every acceptance criterion in docs/requirements.yaml to the specific existing Zig test case that covers it. Found one genuine coverage gap: MIG-01 AC1 (control rows seeded to status=pending, one per enabled tenant, at fanout start) had no direct test -- all existing tests only inspected control rows after runFanout completed (already done/failed). Closed it by adding "TC-MIG-01-AC1-fanout: control rows are seeded pending for every tenant before any step runs" to tests/integration/migration_fanout_test.zig, using a DdlStep (seedCheckingFailingStep) that asserts its own tenant row is pending with null completed_at using the same in-transaction conn it receives, deriving tenant_id from schema_name to avoid any module-level shared state (T020). Fail-first confirmed live: temporarily changed the seed SQL literal from pending to done in src/platform/migration_fanout.zig, reran, watched the new test go red with TestExpectedPendingStatus while the other 7 tests stayed green, then reverted (diff confirmed identical to original) and reran green. Two other ACs were found genuinely out of scope for this batch, not silently dropped: DDL-05 AC5 (first-failure-in-statement-order) belongs to DDL-01, which does not exist yet (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR already accepted this scoping at Step 01b); MIG-03 AC4 (tenant-onboarding catch-up path) belongs to the onboarding module, also not yet amended, per the design doc's own Open Questions section. MIG-02 AC4 (failure-recording transaction itself fails) is recorded as a narrower documented gap -- deterministic fault injection into pool connection acquisition has no test hook without violating DIRECTIVE T-1, and the behavior it describes only becomes fully testable once MIG-04's resume path exists. MIG-02 AC5 (no cross-connection control-row writes) is a structural invariant verified by source inspection, not a runtime-observable behavior. No error.SkipZigTest found anywhere in any of the three files (grep confirmed zero matches in all three). All three targeted build steps reconfirmed passing after the addition: zig build test-ddl-namespace (10/10), zig build test-integration-mig01 (5/5, unchanged), zig build test-integration-mig02-mig03 (8/8, was 7/7 before the new test). tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration exits 0 with no new isolation issues (139 files checked). tools/lint_handoffs.py exits 0, 0 BLOCKER, 0 new MAJOR.

issues.description: MIG-02 AC4 (failure-recording transaction itself fails, row stays pending) has no direct test in this batch -- deterministic fault injection at that exact point has no test hook without violating DIRECTIVE T-1 (no mocks/stubs of the real pool). Code path matches the requirement per the design doc's Error taxonomy table and the logSwallowedFailure doc comment. Revisit when MIG-04 (resume path) is implemented so a real end-to-end seed-pending -> double-failure -> resume test becomes possible.
